name: calculate_emi
description: Monthly EMI on a reducing-balance loan, with total interest and total payable. Rupees, percent per year and months; the last payment absorbs paise rounding so the loan closes at exactly ₹0.00.

annual_rate_pct.description: Interest rate in percent per year (9 means 9%).

name: amortization_schedule
description: Loan amortisation schedule: opening balance, principal paid, interest paid and closing balance per year (default) or per month. Rupees, percent per year and months; at most 60 rows per call, so page with start_period.

annual_rate_pct.description: Interest rate in percent per year (9 means 9%).

granularity.description: Row size: 'yearly' (12 months per row) or 'monthly'.

start_period.description: First row to return: year or month number, from 1.

name: prepayment_impact
description: Effect of a one-time part-prepayment on a reducing-balance loan: the new EMI or new tenure, and the interest saved. Rupees, percent per year and months.

outstanding_principal.description: Loan balance outstanding today, in rupees.

annual_rate_pct.description: Interest rate in percent per year (9 means 9%).

prepayment_amount.description: One-time part-prepayment in rupees, less than the outstanding amount.

mode.description: 'reduce_tenure' keeps the EMI; 'reduce_emi' keeps the tenure.

name: debt_payoff_plan
description: Pay off several debts from one fixed monthly budget, simulated month by month: payoff order, the month each debt clears, months to debt-free and total interest. Each month interest accrues at annual/12 on the opening balance, minimums are paid, and the rest goes to the target debt; stops at 600 months.

debts.description: The debts to pay off, 1 to 20.

name.description: Label for this debt, unique in the list.

annual_rate_pct.description: Interest rate in percent per year (9 means 9%).

monthly_budget.description: Total paid towards all debts each month, in rupees.

name: sip_future_value
description: Future value of a monthly SIP, with total invested and gains. Contributions at the start of each month (annuity due), returns compounded monthly at annual/12, and the monthly amount stepped up every 12 months. An optional lump sum invested at the start grows at the same rate; its value and the SIP's are then reported separately.

expected_annual_return_pct.description: Expected return in percent per year.

annual_step_up_pct.description: Increase in the monthly amount every 12 months, in percent.

lump_sum.description: One-time amount invested at the start, in rupees; it grows at the same rate. 0 for none.

name: fd_maturity
description: Maturity amount and interest earned on a cumulative fixed deposit. Rupees and percent per year; a part period at the end earns simple interest.

annual_rate_pct.description: Interest rate in percent per year (9 means 9%).

years.description: Deposit tenure in years; 1.5 means 18 months.

name: inflation_adjusted_value
description: Future cost of an amount today after inflation, or the present value of a future amount. Rupees, percent per year and whole years, compounded yearly.

direction.description: 'future_cost': what today's amount will cost later; 'present_value': what a future amount is worth today.

name: loan_affordability
description: Largest new EMI that keeps total EMIs within the FOIR limit of monthly net income, and the largest loan that EMI supports. Rupees, percent per year and months; zero if existing EMIs already reach the limit.

monthly_net_income.description: Take-home income per month in rupees.

existing_monthly_emis.description: EMIs already paid each month, in rupees.

annual_rate_pct.description: Interest rate in percent per year (9 means 9%).

max_foir_pct.description: FOIR limit: maximum total EMIs as a percent of net income.

name: get_client_profile
description: The current client's profile as recorded (for example name, age, city, dependents, income in rupees, notes). Says client_on_file false if there is no client.

name: list_debts
description: The current client's debts: balance in rupees, interest rate in percent per year and minimum monthly payment in rupees. Says client_on_file false if there is no client.

name: list_transactions
description: The current client's transactions, oldest first, filtered by category and an inclusive date range, with debit and credit totals over all matches. Amounts in rupees; says client_on_file false if there is no client.

category.description: Category to match exactly, case-insensitive. Omit for all.

from_date.description: Earliest date to include, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for no limit.

to_date.description: Latest date to include, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for no limit.

limit.description: Most transactions to list; totals still cover every match.
